The 88 Jansen Special and the other 3 cars are not out till next year, 2009 as a paid for download, and sorry, not many people who are on this site are glitchers, except the boost drift 'bug' in Revenge. So you will probably not get many people who know or care about that glitch, though it is rumored if you do do the glitch it may corrupt your game save! Espesially on the PS3.

So you will have to go to maybe the Road Cru site and ask there or Operation Burnout, or jump into a room that is doing that sort of thing and ask, how to do it?

Also when you join a site it is best to do a search of the site and check out the FAQ's, they may help you, though, in your case the only information you will get is the names of the other 3 special cars coming out, next year, from the Legendary Car pack for Paradise.

You could also go to the Criterion forums and ask, though don't shout or you will get some abuse.

And thank you for joining hsgply?

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
